title: An isomorphism of intermediate fields lifts through a normal extension
statement: Let $k\subseteq L$ be an algebraic normal field extension [def-pc-field-extension], where normal means that the minimal polynomial over $k$ of each element of $L$ splits into linear factors in $L[T]$. Let $M_1,M_2$ be subfields of $L$ containing $k$, and let $\tau:M_1\xrightarrow{\sim}M_2$ be a field isomorphism fixing $k$. Then there is a field automorphism $\sigma:L\xrightarrow{\sim}L$ fixing $k$ such that $\sigma(m)=\tau(m)$ for every $m\in M_1$. Neither $M_1/k$ nor $M_2/k$ is assumed normal, and no separability or finite-degree assumption is imposed.
